rankingSource.name: TFE Times 2026 Best Master's of Finance ranks 1–8

_meta.rule: Never invent; missing ≠ 0. Tuition figures from primary school pages/PDFs as of asOf.

mit-msf.feesNote: Required course packs included in tuition; textbooks separate. See MIT SFS graduate COA for non-tuition budget (tuition on SFS page should be ignored per MFin page).
mit-msf.notes: SUMMER START (July), not autumn Fall. 12-month = summer+fall+spring; 18-month adds second fall. Low-residency summer option with reduced tuition if 15.401+15.402 completed pre-entry. Not a Fall-2027-only quote.
mit-msf.livingCostNote: School does not publish an MFin-specific living band on the tuition page; points to SFS graduate COA (ignore tuition there).

princeton-msf.feesNote: Student Health Plan (SHP) fee $4,220 AY; tuition+SHP total $69,430 per year (Graduate School rates).
princeton-msf.notes: M.Fin. typically 4 semesters / 2 academic years (compressed 2-semester option for select admits after admission). Two-year tuition ≈ 2×$65,210 before SHP; SHP charged each year of enrollment. Missing ≠ full-degree total.

livingCostBand.basis: Princeton Graduate School published living expenses 2026–27: $33,141 (10 months) / $39,770 (12 months) — housing, food, personal, books & supplies.

sources: BCF Apply / program length & fees pointer

washu-msf.tuitionLabel: Corporate Finance concentration total tuition (Fall 2026 starters, 2 semesters)
washu-msf.tuitionAltLabel: Quantitative OR Wealth & Asset Management total tuition (Fall 2026 starters, 3 semesters)
washu-msf.feesNote: Per semester posted Spring 2026: program fee $900 + student government $100 + health/wellness $350 = $1,350/semester. Corporate (2 sem) ≈ $2,700 fees; Quant/W&AM (3 sem) ≈ $4,050 fees. Health insurance separate (required).
washu-msf.period: 2026–27 (Fall 2026 starters; Fall 2027 cohort rates not yet separately posted as of asOf)
washu-msf.notes: Flat program tuition; three concentrations with different length/cost. Page labels costs for candidates starting Fall 2026. Living/health insurance not in tuition.

gsu-msf.feesNote: Nonrefundable seat deposit $250. Published figures are program costs; GA residents $38,822; non-GA $47,987. Tuition subject to change.
gsu-msf.period: as published on program page (Fall 2027 cycle; subject to change)
gsu-msf.notes: Evening weekday program at Buckhead Center (5:30–9:45 p.m.); STEM-designated. 12- or 16-month options. Costs may be offset with graduate assistantship (see awards).

usc-msf.tuitionLabel: Estimated tuition for 36-unit / 3-semester program at 2025–26 per-unit rate ($2,541/unit)
usc-msf.feesNote: Mandatory fees total $3,396 over 3 semesters as published; total estimated tuition+fees $94,872. Excludes housing, health insurance, transport, food.
usc-msf.period: estimate using 2025–26 rates (page notes typical 3–5% annual increases; Fall 2027 rates not locked)
usc-msf.notes: STEM. Fall start only. Official USC tuition published annually; this is an estimate at time of publishing on Marshall page.

brandeis-msf.feesNote: 9-month / Y1: fees $220. 16-month Y2 fall: fees $60. Orientation fee $100 first term (FAQ/admissions materials). Health insurance estimate $4,685 (waivable) on tuition calculator.
brandeis-msf.notes: STEM. Fall 2027 and Spring 2027 starts available for MSF. Living expenses published on same calculator (food/housing $20,970 for 9 months).

livingCostBand.basis: Brandeis SFS 2026–27 MSF estimated living: Food and Housing $20,970 (9 months); plus books $750, transport $495, personal $3,340; health insurance $4,685 listed separately.

utah-msf.feesNote: Program page: fixed rate includes all standard fees. Living separate.
utah-msf.period: as published (fixed program rate; not labeled to a single AY on page)
utah-msf.notes: Same rate for residents and non-residents. Fall 2027 and Spring 2027 starts. No graduate assistantships or fellowships from the program (per page).

texas-msf.tuitionLabel: Non-Texas resident total program tuition (incl. $2,000 pre-enrollment fee)
texas-msf.feesNote: Non-refundable $2,000 pre-enrollment tuition fee required to secure seat (included in $59,700 total). Texas resident total $55,600. Intl students also responsible for international health insurance + ISSS fees (amounts not on MSF tuition page).
texas-msf.period: as published on MSF tuition page (class of 2028 / summer-start cycle)
texas-msf.notes: SUMMER START (July) — ~10-month in-residence. Non-TX breakdown: Summer $11,900 + Fall $22,900 + Spring $22,900 + $2,000 pre-enroll = $59,700. Books/living/laptop/optional fees extra.
